description: LC15's request desk bound refused out loud (S55 T5): a sixth open stop request on one loop is refused with the count and the limit named in the what, data.kind 'request-limit'. A silent drop would leave an agent's ask unheard with no row and no event; the refusal is the person's signal that the desk is full and the loop is the one that is stuck.

error.message: the loop control refused the operation

data.what: loop stop request refused: the loop already has 5 open stop requests (the limit is 5)
data.means: the daemon understood and declined — nothing was written and nothing moved
